question: Should `openclaw/plugin-sdk/reply-payload` publicly guarantee the generic tool-progress kind and predicate for third-party producers and channels?
rationale: The runtime correction is coherent, but the patch turns bundled-plugin coordination into a durable external API; repository compatibility policy requires maintainer intent before that contract ships.

options.title: Approve the public contract
options.body: Keep the exports, document that only transient non-semantic tool chrome may use them, and add focused direct SDK contract coverage.

options.title: Keep the signal internal
options.body: Remove the public exports and preserve the invariant through the narrowest bundled-only or internal reply metadata seam.

recommendation.title: Approve the public contract
recommendation.body: Keep the exports, document that only transient non-semantic tool chrome may use them, and add focused direct SDK contract coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged history and current review discussion make this the strongest routing candidate across the affected Codex, Slack delivery, and plugin-SDK surfaces.
